name: linalg_solve_ex
description: ATen schema: aten::linalg_solve_ex(Tensor A, Tensor B, *, bool left=True, bool check_errors=False) -> (Tensor result, Tensor info). Solves AX=B and returns the solution plus an int32 status tensor. Pinned master tests for this public operator cover unbatched and batched systems with left=True and default check_errors=False; they compare the solution and info. This coverage does not establish gradients, singular/error behavior, broadcast batches, empty batches, explicit aliasing, or left=False behavior.
